vitrification.details: The Spotiton V1.0 robot was operating at room temperature and moderate humidity..

single_particle_preparation.details: Protein was incorporated into lipid nanodiscs.

singleparticle_processing.details: Energy filter slit width of 15 eV was used during the collection and was aligned automatically every hour using Leginon.

startup_model.details: Ab initio model was generated in CryoSPARC

initial_angle_assignment.details: Non-uniform refinement in CryoSPARC was used.

final_angle_assignment.details: Non-uniform refinement in CryoSPARC was used.

final_three_d_classification.details: RELION 3D Classification was used to separate out junk
